title: Deliver production-grade software autonomously
description: End-to-end SDLC from ideation to monitoring via 14-stage pipeline. All deliverables pass 5-Gate Quality System.

title: Architecture & Specification Quality
description: All features have approved BRD + SRS before implementation. No code without spec.

title: Code Quality & Security
description: All code passes Gate 1 (Vigil review) + Gate 2 (QA). Test coverage mandatory.

title: ISO 29110 Compliance
description: 14 work products maintained. Gate 3 (Scribe) required before deploy.

title: Continuous Deployment & Monitoring
description: Gate 4 (deploy + health check) and Gate 5 (post-deploy monitor, error rate <2x baseline).
